answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ember of a task receipt, and the quartz is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
